description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

U.S. Bank is seeking a Python Backend Software Engineer for its Identity and Access Management Automation Team. The role builds and supports backend applications, integrations, and automation that improve operational efficiency and strengthen security and compliance processes.
Software Engineer 1 building Python backend automation, IAM services and APIs, and privileged-access workflows; supports HashiCorp Vault integrations

Responsibilities:
• Design, develop, test, and maintain backend automation solutions using Python
• Build services, APIs, and integrations supporting identity and access management workflows
• Develop automated solutions for privileged-access and local-administrator-access processes
• Support applications and integrations built around HashiCorp Vault and related IAM technologies
• Replace manual and cumbersome processes with scalable, code-driven workflows
• Troubleshoot application errors, integration failures, and production issues
• Perform software enhancements, bug fixes, maintenance, and patching
• Work with team members and business partners to identify processes that can be streamlined through automation
• Apply sound software design, architecture, testing, and development practices
• Deliver solutions that support operational efficiency, risk reduction, compliance, and cost avoidance
• Contribute to future opportunities involving cloud automation, artificial intelligence, and large language models

Requirements:
• This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship
• Strong professional Python development experience, including building and maintaining backend applications or services
• Experience designing, developing, testing, and supporting production software
• Strong software engineering fundamentals, including application design, architecture, testing, debugging, and maintainable code
• Demonstrated experience independently troubleshooting technical problems and researching root causes
• Experience developing APIs, integrations, automation workflows, internal tools, or backend services
• Experience with JavaScript and/or TypeScript
• Ability to take ownership of technical solutions and deliver working software, rather than only providing recommendations
• Curiosity, initiative, and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems and technologies
• Bachelor's degree, or equivalent work experience

Preferred:
• Docker experience
• AWS or other cloud-platform experience
• Identity and Access Management experience
• HashiCorp Vault or other secrets-management platform experience
• Experience with privileged-access or access-management workflows
• Full-stack application-development experience
• Experience with cloud identities or cloud-based automation
• Experience building automation that supports security, risk, compliance, or operational processes
• Interest or experience integrating AI or large language model capabilities into enterprise workflows
